as_told.title: Rangemen took the tall whites for ancient Egyptians because of their hieroglyphic writing

plain: In the 1960s, some of the men working the range in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, took the Tall Whites, the tall, pale beings Charles Hall says lived there, for ancient Egyptians who had somehow got into the valley, been trapped, and were "still using their own hieroglyphics." Hall, who says he spent three years around these beings, repeats on two episodes with Michels what his fellow rangemen thought, which suggests the beings used a script that looked like Egyptian writing.
